title: Auction parameters need a Governance Poll while ordinary risk parameters do not, but an emergency bypass exists
content:
A.4.4.1.3.6.1 delegates broadly: the Core Executor Agents, consulting the Core Council Risk Advisor, "have the ability to modify any of the parameters" in the stUSDS risk set, "pursuant to the Operational Weekly Cycle," directly via Executive Vote and "without requiring a Governance Poll."

A.4.4.1.3.6.1.1 then carves out a specific list — `Calc`, `Tau`, `Buf`, `Cusp`, `Tail`, `Chip`, `Tip`, `Chop`, `Hole` — for which "a clear justification and analysis must be provided" and approval "through a Governance Poll" must be obtained first.

The carve-out is not arbitrary: those are the parameters that shape **liquidation auction behaviour and its incentives** — the price decrease curve, the starting price buffer, the abort thresholds, the keeper compensation, the penalty, and the per-batch cap. Get them wrong and liquidations either fail to clear (leaving bad debt for stUSDS holders to absorb) or clear far below fair value (destroying borrower equity). Unlike a rate tweak, a bad auction configuration is discovered only under stress, when it is too late to iterate.

So the tiering principle is: parameters whose errors surface immediately and reversibly get fast-path treatment; parameters whose errors surface only during a crisis get the slow path plus a written justification.

The qualification matters, though: "in an emergency, the Core Executor Agents have the authority to bypass the Governance Poll and add the proposed parameters directly to an Executive Vote." The Poll is a default rather than a hard gate, and the emergency condition is not defined here as tightly as the freezer multisig standards define theirs — leaving the boundary of the exception to the Executor Agents' judgment.
description: Core Executor Agents may change most stUSDS risk parameters via Executive Vote alone; Calc, Tau, Buf, Cusp, Tail, Chip, Tip, Chop and Hole require justification plus a Poll — waivable in emergencies.
